description: For an infinite cardinal lambda and cardinals mu less than kappa with kappa at most mu to the lambda, kappa to the lambda equals mu to the lambda.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.ContinuumFunction.smaller_base_reduction.{u} (κ τ μ : Cardinal.{u}) (hτ : Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ τ)
  (hμ : μ < κ) (hpower : κ ≤ μ ^ τ) : κ ^ τ = μ ^ τ
